notes: After a restart the player bar and the lock screen come back to the song you played most recently, so a song from the catalogue can no longer come back over a song from your library that you played after it.

Both players now write one shared record of the song that started playing, and the deck writes down when it saved its own place, so the bar follows the last real play instead of each player assuming it was the one that mattered.
A catalogue song is only brought back when it really was the last thing you played, and it still comes back paused at the second it stopped on.
